svg.text: A1 hotend sensor → EBB42 adapter · wiring
Point-to-point, no perfboard. Every coloured line is one wire. Grey dots are solder joints. All parts shown from the top / component side.
check pin labels on your clone's silkscreen
check pin 1 on the cable's printing
legs G A R B → GPIO 9 10 20 21
longest leg = A, driven HIGH by GPIO10
check each leg with a 3 V coin cell
dashed = wire runs under the SuperMini to the G pad.
The G pad takes 2 wires: sensor GND and EBB GND.
